title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Schedule of Partial-Hours Earnings Rates on a Supplemental Correction
content:
For a supplemental correction on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record, the earnings deduction of the corrected week depends on the hours reported for that week, measured against the full-time hours threshold applied to the corrected week.

| Hours reported for the corrected week | Earnings deduction |
|---|---|
| Below 0.5 of the full-time hours threshold (the low-hours fraction) | 0.5 times the earnings above the disregard, rounded to the cent |
| At least 0.5 but below 0.75 of the threshold (the mid-hours fraction) | 0.75 times the earnings above the disregard, rounded to the cent |
| At or above 0.75 of the threshold | Every dollar above the disregard |

## The bands for two thresholds

| Threshold | 0.5 rate applies below | 0.75 rate applies from … to below | Full deduction from |
|---|---|---|---|
| 32 hours | 16.0 hours | 16.0 to 24.0 hours | 24.0 hours |
| 36 hours | 18.0 hours | 18.0 to 27.0 hours | 27.0 hours |

### Hypothetical cases (32-hour threshold, earnings of 96.20 above the disregard)

- 12.0 hours: deduction 48.10.
- 20.0 hours: deduction 72.15.
- 24.0 hours: deduction 96.20.
